Thomas made his usual rounds, trimming the lamp wick, logging the barometric pressure, then stepped outside onto the gallery to breathe salt air. He stood a long time looking at the horizon where the darkness met the water, unsure whether the message was a plea or a promise, then went inside to wire the coast guard.", "w02": "凌晨四点的城市像一幅未完成的画。路灯将橙黄的光晕投在湿漉漉的柏油路上，偶尔一辆出租车划过，尾灯在积水里拉出一道红痕。便利店的玻璃门后，收银员趴在柜台上打盹，荧光灯白得刺眼。环卫工人推着橙色的垃圾车，轮子在石板缝里发出低沉的咕噜声。远处的立交桥上，几辆货车鱼贯而行，轰鸣声在楼宇间回荡后消散。这座城市还没有醒来，却也从未真正睡着，像一个人在最深的梦里仍皱着眉头，准备好随时起身迎接另一个漫长的白天。", "w03": "• Recursion is when something refers to itself to solve a problem — like looking up a word in a dictionary and finding the definition uses another word you have to look up too.\n• A recursive function solves a big problem by breaking it into a slightly smaller version of the same problem, then an even smaller one, and so on, until it reaches a simple case it can answer directly.\n• Think of it like a set of Russian nesting dolls: each doll contains a smaller copy of itself, and you keep opening them until you reach the tiny one at the center that holds no more dolls — that is where the answer lives."}
